description: Turns a coordinate into words: the nearest address, settlement and motorway junction with their distances, and the Gemeinde, Kreis and Land the point lies in. Use when you already HAVE a lat/lon and need to say where that is. Do NOT use to look up a place or address BY NAME — that is find_place, find_poi or find_address; this only goes coordinate to words. Those three come from the municipality the point lies in (by its official key), not from the nearest Kreis point; near the national border the answer says so. OpenStreetMap ODbL 1.0 for the address; show the attribution line.

language.description: Set this on every call to the language the person is writing in: "en" if they wrote English, "de" if they wrote German. Do not leave it out: it defaults to German ("de"), which is only the fallback when the language is genuinely unclear, so an English question sent without it is answered in German — a wrong answer. Place names, station names and road numbers are never translated in either language; in English the German term is kept in parentheses so the person recognises it on signs and in local apps.

lat.description: Latitude of the point to describe (WGS84).

lon.description: Longitude of the point to describe (WGS84).

name: describe_location
